lines.text: Everyone brought the materials Levi asked for again.
This time, everyone brought the same amount!
I, the unparalleled clever Bahamut, pondered deeply.
Ah, how wise I was to use the road roller!
I, the unparalleled clever Bahamut, took action.
I set the road roller ablaze to heat it up, then gleefully rolled it over the materials.
The materials flattened and stuck to the roller.
I, the unparalleled clever Bahamut, felt a surge of pride.
I, the unparalleled clever Bahamut, pondered again.
Only by surpassing my limits can I reach the ultimate truth!
I, the unparalleled clever Bahamut, thought hard.
Is there a way to exceed my limits and gather even more materials?
I, the unparalleled clever Bahamut, overheard something.
When someone asked whether they could bring any materials, Levi said, "Anything will do, even a building!"
I, the unparalleled clever Bahamut, came to a brilliant realization.
I shall make a colossal roller... and flatten entire buildings to snatch them up!
Truly, I, the unparalleled clever Bahamut, am the epitome of genius!
